line: Crowley's Seven of Wands is the card for the third decan of Leo, with Mars as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Leo.

quotes.quote: The Seven of Wands is called Valour.
the card is also attributed to Mars in Leo.

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: The army has been thrown into disorder; if victory is to be won, it will be by dint of individual valour
